tour.title: Pick a chapter
tour.text: Each tab is a region, with an overview of the chokepoints and shockwaves in it. Once a region is open, a second row lists everything inside it, one chapter each.

tour.title: Read the map
tour.text: Dark gates are chokepoints, red rings are shockwaves. Open a region and its places light up; open one place and the map shows only that place. Drag to pan, use + and − to zoom.

tour.title: Open a chokepoint or shockwave
tour.text: Every marker is also a chapter. Hover it for its name, select it to read the analysis. Some chapters add a “View data” button that puts extra layers on the map.
